integrity: Complete internal integral proof and finite checker, with no claim of independent validation or universal originality certification.
scientific_limitations: One generic circulant block, rank at most one; no higher-rank loci or arbitrary pluri-circulants. Literature comparison of original Zaare-Nahandi (2002, 2004) was limited to abstracts and downstream full-text discussion. Independent audit has not occurred.
title: Wild-characteristic thickening of the rank-one circulant determinantal scheme
